name: Smoked meat
summary: Smoked meat served at the Ban Ang village meal.
origin: Ban Ang. The Vietnam National Authority of Tourism’s 2012 feature lists thịt hun khói among the local dishes and does not name the animal.
howToEat: Eat it with the Ban Ang meal. A smoke time and a cut were not printed.
The price is Check on arrival.
where: Bản Áng, about 2 km south of the farm town on National Highway 43.
